text:
andrea: Heads up — alert from the SLO dashboard: token-level tail latency for /v1/generate is drifting up since last canary. P95 stable, P99 has a ramp. Screenshot + panels: https://graf.redwood/s/ux7 (batch hist, queue_wait, kernel-choice heatmap)

kai: Thanks. Any obvious kernel-selector flips or KV cache anomalies around the same time?

andrea: kvcache hit-rate for long-context routes dropped ~8% starting at 14:03 UTC, coincides with canary. Kernel selector logs show more fallbacks to int8-fast where we used to pick fp16-opt.

sherman: I pulled the batch size histograms — mean batch size for /v1/generate-route-foo went 12 -> 6 after the canary. Queue wait distribution shifted right for short requests. Looks like scheduler sampling window change.

maria: I shipped a tweak to scheduler sampling-window in canary yesterday to reduce tail flapping. Rollout was limited but maybe routing amplified it for that route. Rolling a canary rollback now.

deploy-bot: deploy rollback to config/scheduler/sampling-window:v2026-03-18-rc1 started by maria (canary -> previous).

andrea: Good. Quick profiling note — when kernel selector picks int8-fast we see lower GPU time but KV cache misses + smaller batches inflate queue_wait and end-to-end token latency. Profiler snippet (for the problematic trace):

```
TRACE: request_id=fd2b
queue_wait_ms=420
kernel_selection: int8-fast (score: 0.72)
kernel_compute_ms=85
kvcache_hit=false
end_to_end_token_ms=540
```

kai: That matches — compute down but queuing + mem fetchs up. We should add a per-route kernel-choice panel (stacked by kernel) and token-level breakdown (queue_wait | kernel_compute | kv_fetch) so we can triage automatically.

sherman: Also recommend a lightweight KV warm-up on route activation + temp batching-until-x to prevent batch collapse for low-concurrency spikes. Experiment: hold requests up to 50ms to aggregate into >8 batches for this route.

maria: After rollback I see initial metrics trending back. Can we task someone to run a short A/B that reverts sampling-window but applies warm-up + kernel penalty tweak? Want to avoid full revert if we can tune.

andrea: Action items:
- kai: run compare profiling (canary vs rollback) focused on per-token decomposition and kernel-choice distribution (15m).
- sherman: prototype 50ms batch-hold + KV warm-up hook and a dashboard panel for batch-size CDF per-route.
- maria: hold further canaries until we validate.

ops-bot: alert acknowledged by andrea, kai.

kai: on it, starting profiling job now (`/scripts/profiler/run_compare.sh --routes /v1/generate-route-foo --window 15m`). Will post results. :thumbsup:

andrea: Thanks — if profiling confirms, we'll add a new perf regression alert that triggers on P99-token SLO + kernel-fallback-rate > 5% for a route.

maria: rollback finished, canary instances terminated. Observability will be clearer in ~2m.

andrea: Nice work. Let's keep the new panels lightweight — batch-size hist, queue_wait heatmap, kernel-choice stacked area, kvcache-hit trend, per-route P50/P95/P99 token breakdown. Close loop after kai posts profiling.
